Raga: Gandharansh Shadji
Vocal: Shiv Shiv Bhaj Ajaan
A soulful Hindustani classical vocal rendition by Ustad Ghulam Mustafa Khan, featuring “Shiv Shiv Bhaj Ajaan”. The performance highlights the melodic character of the raga and the artist’s expressive voice and mastery of Hindustani classical music.
